reason: A DSH Web UI plugin and skin suite primarily focused on interface customization and enhanced panels, with additional task automation, visualization, remote access, SSH operations, and image-understanding features documented in the README.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供可插拔的主题皮肤、任务看板、Git 图谱、侧边面板、移动端远程访问及 SSH 等界面与工作台扩展。
summaries.en: A pluggable enhancement suite for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI that adds themes, task boards, Git visualization, side panels, mobile remote access, SSH tools, and related workspace features.

capabilities: customizes the DSH Web UI with themes and panels
provides task-board scheduling and agent session execution
renders Git history and branch visualizations
supports paired remote access from mobile or another browser
connects to SSH hosts for terminal access, file transfer, port forwarding, and clustered command execution
sends image references to configured vision endpoints for analysis
